g.text: Rev K engineering draft | Measured module geometry | Hand-soldered USB connector
C1/C2 at U1; C3/C4 at U2; C5 at U3. All capacitors 0805.
U3 includes 4.7k SDA/SCL pull-ups to its internal regulated 3.3V rail.
LED1 GPIO10 / LED2 GPIO0 / LED3 GPIO1. Each channel has its own MOSFET, 220R gate resistor and 10k pulldown.
GPIO4 SDA / GPIO5 SCL / GPIO6 radar RX / GPIO7 radar TX / GPIO3 presence.
Disconnect USB-A before USB-C programming until power isolation is verified.
